description: Occupation Parkings Multimodalité - GPS is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ParkingMap, Grand Paris Sud. Jeu de données des flux pour tous les sites de parking de GPS gérés par ParkingMap. Réfraîchissement toutes les 5 minutes 7/24. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are occupation place, parking. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-12-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
